providers.profile_bio: I specialize in anxiety, depression, and life transitions using evidence-based approaches including CBT and mindfulness.
With over 10 years of experience, I work with adults navigating trauma, grief, and relationship challenges.
I offer a warm, collaborative approach to therapy, focusing on LGBTQ+ affirming care, anxiety, and self-esteem.
I help individuals and couples work through conflict, communication breakdowns, and personal growth using emotionally-focused therapy.
I provide culturally responsive care for individuals dealing with anxiety, identity, and life transitions, drawing from narrative and somatic approaches.
I specialize in OCD, panic disorder, and phobias using ERP and CBT. I believe in practical, evidence-based tools that create lasting change.
I work with adults and adolescents on depression, trauma, and family conflict, integrating DBT and attachment-based therapy.
As a therapist with a background in sports psychology, I support high-performers managing burnout, perfectionism, and performance anxiety.
